newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures closed mixed in thin, dull trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures closed mixed in thin, dull trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures settled a featureless session weaker, but the the spot-July contract ended up on its first notice day.

Today's NYCE weekly spec/hedge report showed the speculators to be holding a heavy net short position of 35.1 percent. The data failed to spark short covering, however, as the technical outlook remains to the downside, analysts said.
Support in the most-active September contract was pegged at 74.05 cents followed by 72.00 cents.
An estimated 3,500 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Monday's official 4,458 lots. Trading sources said activity is expected to thin ahead of the Fourth of July, on Friday.

The July contract went out 1.20 cents higher at 73.75 cents per lb, having ranged from 74.25 to 72.20 cents. Most-active September closed 0.50 lower at 75.90 cents, while the outer months finished 0.55 lower to 0.65 firmer.
Total open interest fell by 695 lots but remained high at 31,764 lots as of Monday, NYCE said.
